entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana, I need to start a return for some cycling shoes I bought recently.
I can certainly look into that for you. To clarify, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's a fit issue. I installed the cleats and took them for one ride, but they just aren't right for my feet. I got some pretty bad blisters.

I'm very sorry to hear that the fit caused blisters. That's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just pull up your order and check the return eligibility for you. One moment.
Alright, I've got your order here. Yes, it looks like you are well within our 90-day return window. I can go ahead and process that for you and get a return label sent to your email.

Okay, that's good news. I'm glad I can get a full refund. Now, since I did have to spend time setting up the cleats and now I have to go through the hassle of repackaging everything, is there any chance you could add a small discount code to my account for my next order? To offset the inconvenience.

I understand the request. While our policy doesn't allow for discount codes on standard returns, I can assure you the process is very simple. I'll email a pre-paid shipping label to you right now. As soon as our warehouse receives the cycling shoes, the full refund will be issued to your original form of payment.
Alright, that's fair. As long as the refund is processed without any trouble. Please send that email over.
Of course. The email with the return label is on its way to you now. Will there be anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you for your help, Diana.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
